newsitem.title: UK: European veg oils end mixed amid thin trade - Dec 23.
newsitem.headline: European veg oils end mixed amid thin trade - Dec 23.

text.p: European vegetable oils ended mixed and thinly traded, with afternoon business confined to just soy oil.
At the close soy oil stood 0.25 to 0.50 guilders easier, with trade on Jan at 89 guilders and Feb/Apr at 90.75. Rape oil finished unchanged to one guilder lower and tradeless.
The palm oil sector was tradeless during the afternoon session, finishing $2.50 to $5 below Friday's close.
Lauric oils also closed tradeless, with selling levels $5 either side of Friday's close.
